exact: maintenance of mitotic sister chromatin cohesion along arms
maintenance of sister chromatin cohesion along arms at mitosis

definition: The process in which the association between sister chromatids of a replicated chromosome along the length of the chromosome arms, is maintained as chromosomes condense, attach to the spindle in a bipolar orientation, and congress to the metaphase plate during a mitotic cell cycle.
label: maintenance of mitotic sister chromatid cohesion, arms
